content.value: The DOM lets JavaScript read and update the document. Event listeners connect user actions to behavior. Use event delegation for dynamic lists and always guard your handlers when elements might be null.

concepts.name: DOM
concepts.description: The browser’s object representation of an HTML document that JavaScript can read and modify.

concepts.name: querySelector
concepts.description: A DOM method that returns the first element matching a CSS selector.

concepts.name: Event listener
concepts.description: A function registered to run when a specific event occurs.

concepts.name: Click event
concepts.description: A browser event fired when a user clicks or activates an element.

concepts.name: Element state
concepts.description: The current data, attributes, classes, or properties associated with a DOM element.

concepts.name: DOM update
concepts.description: A change to the document object model that affects page structure, content, or attributes.
